capabilities: Find a path between two notes via forward-links
Travel between notes through shared tags
Skip hub notes (MOCs) to take the scenic route
Copy the result as links or transclusions
disambiguation: Not a journaling or daily-log tool; it searches the link graph between two existing notes and outputs the found path as an outline.
extras: Documentation includes a YouTube tutorial and a step-by-step path-finding deep dive with an example four-note vault; feature direction is voted on with the community.
motivation: The author had hundreds of atomic notes but found it hard to extract a good story from the vault and take creative output further.
problem: With many atomic notes, it is hard to extract a story or outline connecting two notes through the existing link graph.
summary: Link path-finder that discovers a chain of notes between two notes and outputs it as an outline for articles or books.
